explicit_exceptions.orientation: Intentionally stage-facing; torso/head do not rotate toward arbitrary movement. Fists continuously follow rest/punch/slam/sweep/interpolation paths and real attack aim. Preserve unified material, gate motion, anchors and existing phase clocks.

Native spin/fly animation deliberately directionless. Continuous vx/vy, homing angular steering, lob z/vz/grav, circular impact, light and particle trails are retained. No whole-sprite bitmap rotation or8way velocity quantization.
Public compatibility helper; no EnemyKind dispatch currently uses it. Its dir_anim path and death burst must resolve diagonals with the shared contract.

Death bursts use the precise selected appearance+pose; particles keep continuous velocities. Saved player/hound ghosts keep captured cell+anchor+flip; shader silhouettes intentionally cast no solid surface. Sproutling trail keeps source appearance and facing.

No NPC, bird, fish, butterfly or separate moving animal actor exists in current source. Grass/leaves/water/lava/fungi/background effects are scenery with intentional local continuous/procedural motion; no8way character rows required.

Motes are directionless glow pickups with continuous homing pull; region shards bob/spin, and ending shards follow continuous Bezier paths with a native spin cycle. They have no authored body-facing or held weapon. Preserve these expressive continuous paths.

Gate closed/opening/open is fixed frontal architecture. Title Glint is an intentionally fixed east-facing scripted idle/charge/dash with screen-space scarf and recorded echoes; it uses the same preserved native right-facing hero rows. Normal play gets eight-way facing through Player.

render_invariants: Precise gameplay aim remains continuous; visual dir alone quantized.
Preserve collision radii, normalized movement speed, control bindings, hit timing/reach/damage.
Native albedo+normal registration; one mirror X-negation; stable ground_y and per-column support.
Idle/turn near-boundary selection stable; attacks, dash, hurt, death and saved ghosts use selected native pose.
Foreground reveal uses actual hero frame; y-sort from feet; blade/scarf attachment metadata valid for every new key.
